posts.name: Chaosmancer
posts.cooked:
So, I knew I wanted to update my posts about how much stuff we are getting (I like to figure it out and write it down anyways so why not share it) but I also wanted to wait for the 1 million stretch goal so we can get an idea of actual size here. So, from the top if you will.

 

OblivAeon base game comes with:

 

5 base hero decks which are Luminary, The Harpy, Akash'Thriya, La Commadora, and Lifeline.

2 villain cards for OblivAeon along with 5 different shield cards

10 different Scions

As well as an OblivAeon Deck, Aeon Men Deck, Scion Deck and Mission Deck.

 

As stretch goals:

We unlocked an additional 6 hero decks which are Stuntman, Benchmark, and the 4 Void Guard

 

We unlocked 2 new Environments: Fort Adamant and the Nexus of the Void

 

We unlocked a lot of promo heroes:

"Old Heroes"-> 17

Omnitrion-U, Parse: Fugue State, Extremist Sky-Scraper, Captain Cosmic (Whispers of OblivAeon?), Visionary Unleashed, Completionist Guise, X-Treme Prime Wardens (Argent Adept, Fanatic, Captain Cosmic, Haka, and Tempest), Freedom Five (Legacy, Bunker, The Wratih, Tachyon and Absolute Zero), and Ra: The Setting Sun

"New Heroes"-> 11

Luminary (Hero of the People?), Dark Watch The Harpy, Stuntman (Ramboscade?), Benchmark: Supply and Demand, Akash'Thriya: Spirit of the Void, La Comodora: Curse of the Black Spot, Lifeline: Bloodmage, The Void Guard: Dr. Medico: Malpractice, Mainstay: Road Warrior, Super Sentai Idealist, and Cosmic Inventor Writhe

 

For a total of 28 new variants.

 

Then there is the Hero Variant pack, which should include around 67 Hero Variant cards with brand new art and the Foil Hero Collection which should ahve around 110 foiled hero cards. We also now have 33 Villain Oversized Foil Cards.

 

And the awesome Collector's box.

 

Oh, and there is a comic as well.

 

So, looks like (5+2+4+6) 17 new decks of cards with (28 stretch goal+67 variant pack+110 foil) around 205 variant normal sized cards and the 33 oversized cards.

 

This is utterly ridiculous and I love it. Of course, feel free to correct any mistakes I might have made, I'm posting this rather late after all

I know we're still a week away from the end, but I just took a glance at Kicktraq and saw some numbers.

 

Our day of lowest funding was Feb. 24 where we raised $12,052 dollars.

Our day of smallest new backers was was the same with only 93 new backers.

 

Looking at the funding line graph it is simply a steadily rising almost flat looking line, with the funding goal so far below it it is almost impossible to see the bottom of the graph.

 

We're also, just for the sake of numbers, currently 2,886% funded and trending towards almost 1.5 million dollars.

 

This campaign has broken every expectation I've ever had about kickstarter campaigns.
